records.observation: TreeMap subclass serialVersionUID=500, Integer line ID keys -> Integer[] hierarchy values. Default/int constructors set node count zero/provided, labels/methods null. YCoordMap constructor takes columns-1, title, column labels and methods by reference; warns but continues on label/flattened array length mismatch, then consumes each row key followed by node values. Duplicate key put replaces value. toYCoordMap allocates size*(nodes+1) ints and writes each key plus ACTUAL value-array length in key order; explicit IllegalStateException only for underfill after loop, overfill can hit array bounds first. Methods converted to index int array if nonempty else null; passes metadata to new YCoordMap. Labels setter warns on size mismatch but stores same array; getters expose references. Writer stores title, int node count, exactly node-count labels, int map size, key + exactly node-count ints per row, signed-short method count and all Method objects. Reader allocates labels from node count, reads count rows and puts without clearing prior map, then positive signed-short method count or null. No explicit count/range validation. toString emits title/labels/numbered entries/methods. main write mode parses dimensions, enumerates Permutation arrays twice via clone, shuffles, assigns keys starting 10001, writes tmp_LineIDMap.dat; any other mode reads that file. File streams closed on success; IO catches print/exit1; no args guard; demo not executed. YCoordMap internals remain unread.
